about_the_game:
In a world torn apart by endless war and chaos, where undead forces of the long night roam the kingdom and consume the remnants of humanity, you are forced to embark on a journey to find peace and hope.

In this Grim and Dark Survival Action RPG, you have to participate in large-scale battles and explore unforgiving wilderness that leads you and your companions closer to the last resort of the survivors’ newly formed kingdom – the place called Raiderheim.

Scavenge the wilds, trade with survivors, and fight through brutal battles in a world inspired by Nordic myth and The Walking Dead series.

Can you reach Raiderheim – the last still-burning campfire of men – to join the Brotherhood of Survivors?

🩸 Key Features 🩸

  • Large-Scale Battles Epic, large-scale conflicts unfold between human warbands, beasts, and the undead. Join the fray, manipulate the outcome, or vanish into the fog and let chaos consume the field.

  • Brutal Combat Real-time, tactical hack-and-slash combat awaits you with tons of loot as a reward – but you must choose your opponents wisely.
    There is no magic potion to restore your health instantly.

    Wounds attract enemies and beasts, and healing takes time, making every encounter tense and strategic.

  • Survive Through Action Hunt, trade, and scavenge to survive the cold, the hunger, the wounds, and the foggy, hostile nights.
    Forge weapons, shelters, medicine, and consumables to endure the journey.

  • Explore a Dying Realm Wander semi-procedural wilds, swamps, ruins, and other regions shaped by day–night cycles and dynamic weather.
    Each discovery rewards exploration points and lore fragments.

  • Storytelling Meet NPCs with their own motives and self-interest – some will help, but others may betray you.
    Unravel a saga inspired by Viking myth, set in a world bleeding through its darkest times.

⚔️ Playable Cast ⚔️

  • The Hunter – The shadow warrior of the wilderness.
    A master survivor skilled in traps, disguise, and ranged combat. Agile and cunning, the Hunter can evolve to tame wild beasts or command the raw forces of nature.

  • The Raider – A brute-force, Viking-born berserker.
    Less tactical but unstoppable, confronting foes head-on and enduring wounds no other could.
    Wielding devastating two-handed weapons, the Raider becomes a raging force on the battlefield – one no man should dare challenge.

  • Other character classes are currently in development and will be revealed in future updates.

🌑 Visuals & Tone 🌑

  • A stylized, semi-realistic top-down view drenched in atmosphere – dynamic volumetric fog, shadows, and lights of day and night cycles, with advanced weather effects that immerse you in this dying realm, where the warmth of a campfire feels like home.
    Every sound, every flicker of light, is designed to pull you deeper into this grim and dark world.

All footage and screenshots presented here are captured directly from the first playable builds.
Everything shown is real-time and fully in-game, with no filters or post-processing applied.
Visuals are subject to updates before the first public demo reaches you.

⚒️ Current Status ⚒️

RaiderHeim has reached its first playable state, and development now turns toward player testing and feedback.

A public demo is coming soon, followed by a closed beta for the bravest and earliest supporters – those who have wishlisted, joined the community, and stood with the Brotherhood from the beginning.

Visuals remain in an early stage, as the focus so far has been on forging the gameplay core, combat systems, and the foundations of the world itself.

🕹️ About the Developer 🕹️

Developed by Digital Crow Tree Studio, a game development veteran with two decades of experience across RPG, RTS, and VR genres.
This project marks the first debut as an indie developer – so your support in a form of wishlist and subscribe to the youtube channel is very welcome. <3

This game blends tense survival and grim storytelling with action-packed exploration in a world inspired by Viking myth – into a singular experience: RaiderHeim.

content_descriptors.notes:
This grim, dark fantasy ARPG immerses players in a world where survival is harsh and choices have consequences. Players may encounter violence, blood, and fallen enemies, and can hunt animals, battle monsters, warriors, and beasts. Characters may consume potions or mystical brews that grant temporary buffs, and tavern or settlement scenes may feature drinking or atmospheric smoke, contributing to the gritty, immersive setting.

Combat may leave arrows and other projectiles visibly lodged in wounded enemies, emphasizing the lasting impact of each strike and adding tactical depth to every encounter. The game may include mature themes, grim scenarios, and intense combat, all designed to deepen immersion and roleplaying choices.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for Full HD on Low–Medium settings during Early Access.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-10750H / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Designed for Full HD up to Ultra HD gameplay on High settings in the final release.
